title: Saffron Rush
tagline: Monday afternoon in Saffron Walden, 1987: milk to fetch, Alex to collect at half past three, home for tea.
blurb: Monday afternoon in Saffron Walden, 1987: milk to fetch, Alex to collect at half past three, home for tea. The whole town is yours to drive, with landmarks named as you pass, roadworks and temporary lights, queues at the pinch points, a stately colonel, horse riders and boy racers. Mind the clock!

demo.contains: Level 1 demo: Monday, milk from Waitrose and Alex from school

review.verdict: A whole market town to potter round and a lovely idea at its heart, but it needs more polish before it earns its parking space. Mind how you go.

quote.text: Over eight and a half minutes to load, so that's two cups of tea and a digestive

credits.name: Norm Crabtree, Baz Pocket and Prue Fairley for INK & PAPER
